dedupe_keys.name: nvdb swedish national road database nationell vagdatabas

description: NVDB (Nationell vägdatabas) is Sweden's national road database, created after a government assignment to the Swedish Road Administration in 1996 and regarded as one of the country's base registers. It holds a reference road network with a large amount of data linked to it and contains all Swedish roads for motor vehicles, streets, cycle paths and part of the footpaths. It is a collaboration led by Trafikverket: Trafikverket supplies the state road network and subsidised private roads, all 290 municipalities supply municipal roads, the forest industry supplies private forest roads, Lantmäteriet the remaining private roads, and Transportstyrelsen supplies traffic regulations such as speed limits, one-way streets and overtaking bans. Data products include the cycle road network with basic attributes. Coverage is Sweden. Access: NVDB data are open data, free to use, downloaded through Trafikverket's Lastkajen service and viewable on NVDB på karta, where errors can be reported; Trafikverket also publishes the Swedish national railway database (NJDB) as open data. Caveats: the NVDB pages do not name a licence (Trafikverket states it generally releases open data under CC0), Lastkajen is a web application that needs JavaScript, and regulations valid for six months or less are not included. It supports road network topology, routing and accessibility analysis, hazard exposure of roads and cascading failure studies, and complements the Norwegian NVDB and Trafikverket's open API catalogued here.
